title: Contact — Sephiria Guide
description: Contact sephiria-guide.com for corrections, questions, or advertising inquiries.
meta: Unofficial fan guide · Not affiliated with Team Horay · Last updated: 2026-11-10
body:
Email: jeromell@be-winner.com. This is a one-person fan site, so the same address handles corrections, questions about a page, and anything else worth passing on.

What to write about

  • Corrections. Include the page URL, the sentence that needs review, what you saw in-game instead, and a source that can be re-checked — a patch note, a Steam post, a dated guide or a screenshot of the current menu.
  • Numbers that look wrong. Fountain capacity, rarity costs, stage counts and upgrade values are the usual suspects. Say which build you are on, because a number that is wrong today may have been right in 1.0.
  • Broken links and dead pages. A 404, a link that lands on the wrong guide, or an image that no longer loads is worth a short mail with the URL you started from.
  • Steps that no longer work. If an unlock route or menu path has changed, the exact wording of what you see now is more useful than a description of what failed.
  • Questions the site does not answer. A specific question with the page you expected to find is a useful signal for what to write next.

What to expect

Mail is read by one person, on a best-effort basis. There is no ticket system and no response-time promise; most corrections are handled in batches when pages are next revised. If a fix checks out, the page is edited and, where it carries one, its last-checked line moves to the new date. If a report cannot be verified, the page keeps its hedge rather than switching to an unconfirmed claim.

If you need an answer to keep playing tonight, the in-game Journal and the Steam discussions will usually be faster than waiting for a site update. The Journal is also the place where the item and upgrade text matches your build.

What is out of scope

  • Cheats, trainers, save editing, mod installation and piracy. None of it is supported or linked here.
  • Account problems: refunds, bans, cloud saves and purchase issues are handled by Steam Support, not by this site.
  • Requests to play a run, carry a lobby or review a build for you.
  • Advertising placements, paid links, sponsored posts and link exchanges. Ads on the guide pages are served by Google AdSense; placements are not for sale, and no payment changes what a page says.

How email is handled

Messages go to the address above and are used to reply or to fix a page. There is no newsletter and no mailing list, so nothing is signed up on your behalf. If a correction leads to an edit, the change may be described on the page in general terms; your name is not attached unless you ask for it. Anything about sign-in data, including a request to delete an account record, goes to the same address and is covered by the privacy policy.

Before writing, check the page’s Sources list and version line. A figure that disagrees with an older guide is often two different builds rather than an error, and the editorial policy explains how that is handled.

See also About, Privacy, and Editorial policy.
